title: Performance of ChatGPT on USMLE: Potential for AI-assisted medical education using large language models
authors: Kung, Tiffany H.; Cheatham, Morgan; Medenilla, Arielle; Sillos, Czarina; De Leon, Lorie; Elepaño, Camille; Madriaga, Maria; Aggabao, Rimel; Diaz-Candido, Giezel; Maningo, James; Tseng, Victor
abstract: <jats:p>We evaluated the performance of a large language model called ChatGPT on the United States Medical Licensing Exam (USMLE), which consists of three exams: Step 1, Step 2CK, and Step 3. ChatGPT performed at or near the passing threshold for all three exams without any specialized training or reinforcement. Additionally, ChatGPT demonstrated a high level of concordance and insight in its explanations. These results suggest that large language models may have the potential to assist with medical education, and potentially, clinical decision-making.</jats:p>
